name: Eastlink
context: Eastlink’s cable and fibre network includes Atlantic Canadian communities. These network-wide signals can miss a local interruption in Halifax or elsewhere.

name: Rogers
context: This view follows Rogers AS812. Other Rogers and former Shaw networks can use different routing systems. The historical July 2022 example below uses this same ASN.

name: Bell Canada
context: This view follows Bell Canada AS577. For the separate Atlantic network, use the Bell Aliant view. Either view can miss a neighbourhood or mobile service issue.

name: Bell Aliant
context: This view follows Bell’s Atlantic network AS855. A Halifax access issue may have no visible effect on this network-wide signal. Bell Canada AS577 has its own view.

name: TELUS
context: This view follows TELUS AS852. It is useful for checking wide-area changes while investigating home internet issues in communities such as Langley. Mobile, voice and individual lines can behave differently.
